senses.title: A student residence
senses.definition: a building where students sleep and live during term time
senses.definitionCN: 学生在学期内睡觉与生活的楼房
senses.example: The oldest dormitory on campus has been rebuilt.
senses.exampleCN: 校园里最老的宿舍楼已经重建。
senses.why: Latin dormitorium was a sleeping place, and universities turned it into a building that belongs to student life.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 dormitorium 本是睡觉的地方，大学把它变成属于学生生活的整栋建筑。

senses.title: Shared housing for workers
senses.definition: a large shared bedroom or building for workers, nurses or other groups
senses.definitionCN: 供工人、护士或其他群体居住的大型共用寝室或楼房
senses.example: The nurses share a dormitory near the hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 护士们合住医院附近的一栋集体宿舍。
senses.why: The sleeping-place word serves any group that lives together for work, not only students.
senses.whyCN: 这个「睡觉之处」的词不只服务学生，也服务任何因工作而住在一起的人群。

senses.title: A dormitory town
senses.definition: a residential area where people live but travel elsewhere for work, used in British English
senses.definitionCN: 人们居住但去别处上班的住宅区，属英式英语用法
senses.example: The village became a dormitory suburb of the capital.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子变成了首都的睡城郊区。
senses.why: A place where people mainly sleep and then leave each morning is like a whole town turned into a dormitory.
senses.whyCN: 人们主要在此睡觉、每天早晨又离开的地方，就像整座城镇变成了一间宿舍。

intro.en: Dormitory comes from Latin dormitorium, a sleeping place, built on dormire, to sleep.
intro.cn: dormitory 来自拉丁语 dormitorium（睡觉的地方），其根为 dormire（睡）。

items.en: Dormire meant to sleep and supplied the verb root for the whole family.
items.cn: dormire 意为「睡觉」，为整族词提供动词词根。

items.en: Dormitorium named a sleeping room, especially a shared one in a monastery.
items.cn: dormitorium 指睡房，尤指修道院里共用的寝室。

items.en: The word entered English for a shared sleeping room in religious houses.
items.cn: 这个词进入英语，先指宗教团体里共用的寝室。

items.en: Schools and universities used it for large buildings that housed many students.
items.cn: 学校与大学用它指容纳许多学生的大型楼房。

items.en: British planners applied it to dormitory towns and suburbs where people only sleep.
items.cn: 英国规划者把它用到人们只在此睡觉的睡城与郊区。

items.en: The clipped form dorm now competes with the full word in everyday speech.
items.cn: 在日常口语里，缩略形式 dorm 已与全称并用。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin sleep root; the near-meaning group names other group housing.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语「睡」的词根；近义组收的是其他集体住处。

entries.definition: The short everyday form of dormitory.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「宿舍」，是 dormitory 的日常缩略形式。

entries.definition: A window built into a sloping roof.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「屋顶窗」，与 dormitory 同出拉丁语 dormire。

entries.definition: A rare term meaning sleep-inducing.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或名词，义为「催眠的；安眠药」，较少使用。

entries.definition: The formal American name for a student dormitory.
entries.definitionCN: 名词短语，义为「学生宿舍楼」，是美式正式说法。

entries.definition: Cheap shared lodging for travellers, students or workers.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「旅舍、青年宿舍」，供旅行者、学生或工人廉价合住。

entries.definition: A private house that provides rooms and meals for paying residents.
entries.definitionCN: 名词短语，义为「寄宿公寓」，指提供房间与伙食收费的私人住宅。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the real dormire family and the three places it came to describe.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着真实的 dormire 词族，以及它后来描述的三类地方。

normal.en: Dormire is to sleep, so a dormitory is a place built around sleep.
normal.cn: dormire 是睡觉，dormitory 就是以睡觉为中心的地方。

normal.en: The suffix -ory marks a place, as in dormitory.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ory 标记地点，dormitory 正是这样。

normal.en: Dormitory first meant a shared room in a religious house.
normal.cn: dormitory 最初指宗教团体里共用的寝室。

normal.en: The nurses' dormitory shows the word does not belong only to students.
normal.cn: 护士的集体宿舍说明这个词不只属于学生。

normal.en: A dormitory town is a whole place used mainly for sleeping.
normal.cn: 睡城就是整片地方主要只用来睡觉。

abstract.en: Picture a long corridor with a row of wash bags moving toward one sink.
abstract.cn: 想象一条长走廊，一排洗漱袋朝同一个水池移动。

abstract.en: Picture four hundred windows going dark at the same time.
abstract.cn: 想象四百扇窗在同一时间暗下去。

abstract.en: Picture a quiet suburb where every car leaves at seven and returns at six.
abstract.cn: 想象一个安静的郊区，七点车都走了，六点又都回来了。

examples.en: They met on the first day in the dormitory.
examples.cn: 他们在宿舍里第一天就认识了。

examples.en: The hospital provides a dormitory for night staff.
examples.cn: 医院给夜班员工提供集体宿舍。

examples.en: He grew up in a dormitory town outside the city.
examples.cn: 他在城外的睡城长大。

dict_mnemonic.text: dorm 是「睡」，-ory 表示地点：专门用来睡的地方，就是宿舍。

root: 源自拉丁语 dormitorium（睡觉的地方），由 dormire（睡）加地点后缀 -torium 构成。英语十五世纪先指修道院或学校的共用寝室，十九世纪扩展为大型学生宿舍楼，二十世纪又被英国规划者用来指人们只在夜里睡觉的睡城。

sensesIntro.en: From a shared sleeping room, to a student building, a workers' lodging, and finally a whole commuter town.
sensesIntro.cn: 从共用的睡房，到学生宿舍楼、工人集体宿舍，最后到整片通勤者居住的睡城。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long corridor where people carry wash bags before dawn.
core.cn: 核心意象：黎明前的长走廊，人们提着洗漱袋走动。

branches.en: STUDENTS: the first sense is the campus building for students.
branches.cn: 学生线：第一个义项是校园里供学生居住的楼。

branches.en: WORKERS: the second sense is shared housing for nurses and other staff.
branches.cn: 工薪线：第二个义项是护士与其他员工的集体宿舍。

branches.en: THE TOWN: the third sense stretches the sleeping place to a whole suburb.
branches.cn: 城镇线：第三个义项把这个睡觉之处拉伸到整片郊区。

branches.en: Students and workers share the same building type because both need cheap group lodging.
branches.cn: 学生与工人共用同一种建筑，因为两者都需要便宜的集体住宿。

branches.en: A workers' lodging and a commuter town both exist mainly for sleep.
branches.cn: 工人宿舍与睡城的存在，主要都是为了睡觉。

intro.en: Dormitory is dormire plus the Latin place suffix -torium, shortened into English -ory.
intro.cn: dormitory 是 dormire 加拉丁语地点后缀 -torium，进入英语后收为 -ory。

latinIntro.en: Latin dormire and dormitorium are recorded; dormitorius also appears as an adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dormire 与 dormitorium 均有记录，dormitorius 也以形容词形式出现。

items.example: The verb is the base of the name.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是这一名称的基础。

items.example: The noun described a shared room.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指共用的房间。

items.example: It turns the root into dormitory.
The dormitory was full in September.
He moved into a dorm last week.
A dormer lets light into the attic.
The term is now rare and formal.
items.exampleCN: 这个词现在罕见而正式。

items.example: Three dormitories line the path.

definition_zh: 剂量；一剂；一次（不愉快的经历）；给药
definition_en: a measured amount of medicine taken at one time, an amount of something experienced, or to give medicine to someone
core_image: 一只量杯对着标签上的刻度，护士仔细核对
scene: 药瓶上贴着模糊的标签，护士拿量杯仔细对了一遍刻度。The label warns patients not to exceed the daily dose.
sceneCN: 这里 dose 是「剂量」（第 1 个义项：一次服用的、经过计量的药量）；句意是标签警告病人不要超过每日剂量。

pos.zh: 名词：剂量；一剂；一次（不愉快的经历）
动词：给……服药；给……加（某物）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -age 构成，义为「用量；剂量」
由 dose 加 -meter「测量器」构成，义为「剂量计」
由前缀 over-「过量」加本词构成，义为「用药过量；服药过量」

senses.title: A measured amount of medicine
senses.definition: a measured amount of a medicine or drug taken at one time
senses.definitionCN: 一次服用的、经过计量的药量
senses.example: The doctor reduced the dose after the first week.
senses.exampleCN: 第一周之后医生减少了剂量。
senses.why: Greek dosis meant a giving, and medicine turned that giving into an exact quantity measured out for one occasion.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 dosis 意为「给予」，医学把这次给予变成一次称量好的精确数量。

senses.title: An unpleasant experience
senses.definition: an amount of something unpleasant that a person has to experience, such as an illness or a shock
senses.definitionCN: 一个人不得不承受的某种不快之物的分量，如疾病或惊吓
senses.example: He got a dose of flu during the trip.
senses.exampleCN: 旅途中他得了一次流感。
senses.why: If medicine comes in doses, then anything that hits the body or the feelings can also arrive in one measured portion.
senses.whyCN: 既然药可以按剂来算，那么任何冲击身体或情绪的东西也能以一份计量好的分量到来。

senses.title: To give medicine to
senses.definition: to give a person or animal a measured amount of medicine or another substance
senses.definitionCN: 给一个人或动物服用一定量的药或其他物质
senses.example: The farmer dosed the sick calf with a bitter liquid.
senses.exampleCN: 农夫给病牛犊喂了一种苦味的药水。
senses.why: The noun became a verb: to dose is to hand over exactly the measured giving the noun names.
senses.whyCN: 名词变成动词：dose 就是把名词所指的那份计量好的给予交出去。

intro.en: Dose comes through French from Late Latin dosis, which borrowed Greek dosis, a giving.
intro.cn: dose 经法语来自晚期拉丁语 dosis，后者借自希腊语 dosis（给予）。

items.en: Didonai meant to give, and it supplied the root for dosis.
items.cn: didonai 意为「给」，为 dosis 提供词根。

items.en: Dosis meant the act of giving or a portion given, and doctors used it for a measured portion of medicine.
items.cn: dosis 指给予的行为或给出的份额，医生用它指称量好的一份药。

items.en: Late Latin borrowed dosis directly from Greek medical writing.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语从希腊医学文献直接借入 dosis。

items.en: French dose carried the medical sense into everyday use.
items.cn: 法语 dose 把医学义带入日常使用。

items.en: English dose is recorded from the seventeenth century for a quantity of medicine.
items.cn: 英语 dose 自十七世纪有记录，指一定量的药。

items.en: The word widened to doses of flu, doses of reality and the verb to dose.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到「一次流感」「一次现实教训」，并产生动词用法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the giving and measuring root; the near-meaning group names related medical quantities.
note.cn: 形近组共享「给予、计量」的词根；近义组收的是相关医学用量词。

entries.definition: The amount and schedule of medicine prescribed.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「用量、剂量方案」，指处方规定的量与次数。

entries.definition: An instrument that measures radiation dose.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「剂量计」，用来测量辐射剂量的仪器。

entries.definition: An amount of medicine that is too large and dangerous.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「用药过量」，指过大而有危险的药量。

entries.definition: A general word for how much of something there is.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「数量」，泛指某物有多少，范围最广。

entries.definition: A part or share of something larger, often for one person.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「一份、份额」，指较大物中的一部分，常供一人使用。

entries.definition: A doctor's written order for medicine, including its dose.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「处方」，医生开药的书面指示，其中包含剂量。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the real Greek giving root and the measured situations where dose appears.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着真实的希腊语「给」词根，以及 dose 出现的计量场景。

normal.en: Dosis means a giving, and a dose is a giving measured out.
normal.cn: dosis 意为给予，dose 就是称量好的一次给予。

normal.en: Greek didonai, to give, is the older verb behind dosis.
normal.cn: 希腊语 didonai（给）是 dosis 背后更早的动词。

normal.en: Daily dose is the amount allowed in one day.
normal.cn: daily dose 就是一天允许的量。

normal.en: A dose of flu borrows the medicine measure for an illness.
normal.cn: a dose of flu 借用药的计量来说一次流感。

normal.en: The verb dose means to hand over that measured amount.
normal.cn: 动词 dose 就是把那份计量好的量交给对方。

abstract.en: Picture a nurse lining a small cup up against a printed scale.
abstract.cn: 想象护士把一只小量杯对准印好的刻度。

abstract.en: Picture a spoon of bitter liquid held steady beside a sick animal.
abstract.cn: 想象一勺苦药稳稳地举在病畜旁边。

abstract.en: Picture a single spoonful becoming the exact limit for one day.
abstract.cn: 想象一勺药成为一天不可超过的界限。

examples.en: Take the dose with food to avoid stomach pain.
examples.cn: 随餐服用这一剂，以免胃痛。

examples.en: The nurse dosed the child every six hours.
examples.cn: 护士每六小时给孩子服一次药。

examples.en: The trip gave him a dose of cold wind and hard truth.
examples.cn: 这趟旅程给了他一阵冷风和一次现实的教训。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抖死」——剂量过大真会让人抖得厉害；所以 dose 要按刻度来。

root: 源自希腊语 dosis（给予），由 didonai（给）派生，经晚期拉丁语 dosis 与法语 dose 进入英语。本义是「给出的一份」，医学上固定为一次计量好的药量，后又引申指一次不愉快的经历，并产生动词「给药」义。

sensesIntro.en: One giving word measures medicine, measures bad experiences, and finally names the act of giving medicine.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个「给」的词，既计量药，也计量糟糕的经历，最后还指给药这个动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small measuring cup aligned with the marks on a bottle label.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只小量杯对准药瓶标签上的刻度。

branches.en: MEDICINE: the first sense is the exact amount of a drug taken at one time.
branches.cn: 药物线：第一个义项是一次服用的精确药量。

branches.en: EXPERIENCE: the second sense measures illness or shock instead of medicine.
branches.cn: 经历线：第二个义项计量的不是药，而是疾病或冲击。

branches.en: THE ACTION: the third sense is the handing over of that measured amount.
branches.cn: 动作线：第三个义项是把那份计量好的量交出去。

branches.en: The noun and verb face each other: the dose is what the act of dosing delivers.
branches.cn: 名词与动词相对：dose 就是给药动作所交付的东西。

branches.en: Medicine and misfortune both arrive in portions one has to take.
branches.cn: 药与不幸都以人必须承受的一份份分量到来。

intro.en: Dose is a Greek-derived stem; English adds -age, -meter and over- to build its family.
intro.cn: dose 是源自希腊语的词干，英语靠 -age、-meter 与 over- 扩展词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin borrowed dosis from Greek, so the Latin entry is itself a loan word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dosis 借自希腊语，因此这条拉丁条目本身也是借词。

items.example: The Greek verb is the giving root.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊动词是「给」的词根。

items.example: Greek doctors used it for medicine.
The dose is printed on the box.
The dosage depends on body weight.
It forms dosage.
Workers wear a dosimeter.
An overdose can be fatal.
It forms dosimeter.

latinEntries.meaning: a giving, a portion of medicine

definition_zh: 点；小圆点；小数点；加点；点缀；准时
definition_en: a small round mark, the decimal point, to mark or spread over an area, or exactly on time
core_image: 地图上几个墨点，把散落的村庄连成一条路
scene: 地图上的村庄只剩几个墨点，山路细得像线。The child joined the dots to draw a house.
sceneCN: 这里 dot 是「小圆点」（第 1 个义项：用笔点出或印在纸上的小圆痕）；句意是孩子把那些点连起来画成了一座房子。

pos.zh: 名词：点；小圆点；小数点
动词：加点；点缀；散布

collocations.zh: 给字母 i 加点；把细节弄妥

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「带点的；点状的」
由本词加 -y 构成，义为「有点怪的；不很清醒的」（非正式）
由本词加 com 构成，义为「网络公司」，源自网址中的点

senses.title: A small round mark
senses.definition: a small round mark made with a pen or printed on a surface
senses.definitionCN: 用笔点出或印在表面的小圆痕
senses.example: Each village is marked with a red dot.
senses.exampleCN: 每个村庄都用一个小红点标出。
senses.why: The earliest sense is the visible speck itself, the smallest mark a pen can leave.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是那个看得见的小痕，是笔能留下的最小记号。

senses.title: The decimal point
senses.definition: the mark used in British English to separate a whole number from its fraction
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语中用来分隔整数与小数的记号
senses.example: Write the answer as four point five, with a dot between them.
senses.exampleCN: 把答案写成四点五，中间加一个小数点。
senses.why: A decimal point is literally a dot, so British usage simply calls the mark by its shape.
senses.whyCN: 小数点本来就是一个小圆点，英式用法干脆按形状来称呼这个记号。

senses.title: To mark or spread with dots
senses.definition: to mark something with small round marks, or to be spread over an area in separate places
senses.definitionCN: 用小圆痕标记某物，或分散地散布在一片区域上
senses.example: Small farms dot the hillside.
senses.exampleCN: 小农场散布在山坡上。
senses.why: The noun turns into an action: placing dots turns into covering an area with separate small things.
senses.whyCN: 名词变成动作：一个一个点的摆放，变成在一片区域散布许多小东西。

senses.title: Exactly on time
senses.definition: used in the phrase on the dot to mean at exactly the stated time
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 on the dot，表示正好在所说的时刻
senses.example: The train left at nine on the dot.
senses.exampleCN: 火车九点整开走了。
senses.why: A clock face marks each minute with a dot, so arriving on the dot means landing exactly on that mark.
senses.whyCN: 钟面上每一分钟都由一个点标出，因此 on the dot 就是正好落在那个点上。

intro.en: Dot is a word of uncertain origin, first recorded in English in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: dot 来源不确定，在英语中最早于十七世纪有记录。

items.en: The word appears in the seventeenth century; no earlier history is securely established.
items.cn: 这个词在十七世纪出现，更早的历史没有可靠结论。

items.en: One common suggestion compares Dutch dot, a knot or small bunch, but this is not proven.
items.cn: 一种常见说法把它与荷兰语 dot（结、小团）相比，但未获证实。

items.en: Early uses name a small mark or a speck on a surface.
items.cn: 早期用法指表面上的小记号或小斑点。

items.en: The verb to dot and the phrase on the dot both became common.
items.cn: 动词 dot 与短语 on the dot 都在这时通行起来。

items.en: Dotted lines and polka dots entered sewing, printing and fashion.
items.cn: 点线与波点在缝纫、印刷与时尚中使用。

items.en: The internet added dot-com, where the dot is the one in a web address.
items.cn: 互联网时代又加上 dot-com，这里的点是网址中的那个点。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dot stem; the near-meaning group gathers other small marks.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dot 词干；近义组收的是其他小记号。

entries.definition: Marked with dots or made of dots, as a dotted line.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「带点的、点状的」，如点线。

entries.definition: Informal British word for slightly crazy or eccentric.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，英式口语，义为「有点古怪的、不大清醒的」。

entries.definition: An internet company, named after the dot in a web address.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「网络公司」，得名于网址中的点。

entries.definition: A sharp end or a particular position; also a mark in space.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「点、位置、尖端」，也指空间中的标记，范围更广。

entries.definition: A round mark that is usually larger or less regular than a dot.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「斑点」，通常比 dot 更大或更不规则。

entries.definition: A very small piece or mark of dirt or colour.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「微粒、小污点」，指极小的脏物或颜色痕迹。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real uncertain history and the places dots actually appear.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子用真实的来源不确定之说，以及点实际出现的场合。

normal.en: Dot has no proven origin; Dutch dot is only a comparison, not a source.
normal.cn: dot 没有已证实的来源，荷兰语 dot 只是比较，不是定论。

normal.en: A decimal point is called a dot in British usage because of its shape.
normal.cn: 小数点英式称 dot，就是因为它的形状。

normal.en: On the dot means on the exact minute mark of a clock.
normal.cn: on the dot 指正好落在钟面的那一分钟刻度上。

normal.en: Polka dots are round marks repeated all over a fabric.
normal.cn: 波点就是布满布面的重复圆点。

normal.en: Farms that dot a hillside look like separate marks on a map.
normal.cn: 散布在山坡上的农场，看起来就像地图上的一个个点。

abstract.en: Picture one drop of ink falling on paper and staying round.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴墨落在纸上，保持着圆形。

abstract.en: Picture a sheet of dots that a pencil turns into an outline.
abstract.cn: 想象一张点阵纸，被铅笔画出一条轮廓。

abstract.en: Picture a clock hand landing exactly on a tiny mark.
abstract.cn: 想象钟面的指针正好落在一个小点上。

examples.en: Put a dot beside the correct answer.
examples.cn: 在正确答案旁边点一个点。

examples.en: The valley is dotted with small stone houses.
examples.cn: 山谷里散布着一座座石头小屋。

examples.en: She arrived at eight on the dot.
examples.cn: 她八点整到了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「大特」——笔尖在纸上特地点一下，留下一个特别小的圆痕，就是 dot。

root: dot 于十七世纪出现于英语，来源不确定；荷兰语 dot（结、小团）只是常被拿来比较的形式，不能确定为来源。早期指表面上的小记号，后产生动词「加点、散布」义与 on the dot（准时）等说法。

sensesIntro.en: One small mark becomes a decimal point, a way of spreading things over a map, and a clock mark for punctuality.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个小记号，变成小数点、在地图上散布事物的方式，以及衡量准时的钟面刻度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a few ink dots that a line of pencil joins into a shape.
core.cn: 核心意象：几个墨点被铅笔线连成一个形状。

branches.en: THE MARK: the first sense is the visible speck made by a pen.
branches.cn: 记号线：第一个义项是笔留下的可见小痕。

branches.en: THE DECIMAL: the second sense is the same shape used in numbers.
branches.cn: 小数线：第二个义项是同一形状用在数字里。

branches.en: THE SCATTER: the third sense spreads small marks across a whole area.
branches.cn: 散布线：第三个义项把许多小记号铺到一整片区域。

branches.en: THE MINUTE: the fourth sense uses the clock's dots to mean exactness.
branches.cn: 分刻线：第四个义项用钟面上的点表示精确。

branches.en: A single dot and a landscape full of dots are the same shape seen close and far.
branches.cn: 单个点与满布景色的点，是同一形状的近看与远看。

intro.en: Dot has no Latin root; its family is built with English suffixes and compounds.
intro.cn: dot 没有拉丁词根，它的小词族靠英语后缀与复合构成。

latinIntro.en: No Latin cognate of dot is known, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: dot 没有已知的拉丁同族词，所以拉丁条目留空。

definition_zh: 两倍的；双重的；双人的；使加倍；双打
definition_en: twice as much, made for two people, to multiply by two, or a game played by two teams of two
core_image: 一间有两张床的房间，两盏床头灯同时亮着
scene: 旅馆前台只剩一间带两张床的屋子，客人还在犹豫。They booked a double room for the long weekend.
sceneCN: 这里 double 是「双人的」（第 2 个义项：供两个人使用的）；句意是他们订了一间双人房，准备过长周末。

pos.zh: 形容词：两倍的；双重的；双人的
动词：使加倍；翻倍；兼作
名词：两倍；双打；替身演员

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「双重地；加倍地」

senses.title: Twice as much
senses.definition: twice as much in size, amount or number, or made of two similar parts
senses.definitionCN: 在大小、数量或数目上是两倍，或由两个相似部分组成
senses.example: The new machine does double the work of the old one.
senses.exampleCN: 新机器的产量是旧机器的两倍。
senses.why: Latin duplus joined duo, two, to a suffix meaning fold, so double begins as the idea of two folds of the same thing.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 duplus 把 duo（二）接在表示「折叠」的后缀上，所以 double 一开始就是同一物折成两份的意思。

senses.title: Designed for two
senses.definition: designed to be used or occupied by two people
senses.definitionCN: 设计供两个人使用或居住的
senses.example: They shared a double room to save money.
senses.exampleCN: 为了省钱，他们合住一间双人房。
senses.why: The same idea of two applies to a bed or a room, where two people fit into one unit.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「二」的意思用到床或房间上，就是两个人合用同一个单元。

senses.title: To multiply by two
senses.definition: to become twice as much, or to multiply something by two
senses.definitionCN: 变成原来的两倍，或把某物乘以二
senses.example: The price of the room doubled during the festival.
senses.exampleCN: 节日期间房间价格翻了一倍。
senses.why: The adjective becomes a verb: to double is to make the two-fold state happen.
senses.whyCN: 形容词变成动词：double 就是让那种折成两份的状态发生。

senses.title: A doubles match
senses.definition: a game, especially tennis, played by two teams of two players
senses.definitionCN: 尤指网球中由两队各两名选手进行的比赛
senses.example: They won the mixed doubles final in three sets.
senses.exampleCN: 他们三盘赢下了混双决赛。
senses.why: A doubles game is a match with two players on each side, so the word for two names the format.
senses.whyCN: 双打比赛每边两名选手，于是表示「二」的词直接给这种赛制命名。

intro.en: Double comes from Latin duplus, two-fold, through Old French doble.
intro.cn: double 来自拉丁语 duplus（两倍的），经古法语 doble 进入英语。

items.en: Duo meant two, and it is the first element of duplus.
items.cn: duo 意为「二」，是 duplus 的第一个成分。

items.en: Duplus meant two-fold or twice as much, built from duo plus a fold suffix.
items.cn: duplus 意为「两倍的」，由 duo 加表示折叠的后缀构成。

items.en: Old French doble carried the word into English after the Norman period.
items.cn: 古法语 doble 在诺曼时期之后把这个词带入英语。

items.en: Double is recorded in English from the thirteenth century.
items.cn: double 在英语中自十三世纪有记录。

items.en: The verb sense to make twice as much became common in trade and accounting.
items.cn: 动词「使加倍」义在贸易与记账中通行起来。

items.en: The noun now covers doubles in tennis and a double standing in for an actor.
items.cn: 名词义今天覆盖网球双打，以及替演员出场的替身。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin two-fold root; the near-meaning group gathers other words for two.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语「两倍」词根；近义组收的是其他表示「二」的词。

entries.definition: In two ways, or to twice the degree.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「双重地；加倍地」，由本词加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: The act or process of becoming twice as much.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「加倍、翻倍」，指变成两倍的过程。

entries.definition: A close-fitting jacket worn in former times, or one of a pair of similar things.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「紧身上衣；一对中的一个」，与 double 同源。

entries.definition: Two times, used as an adverb of frequency or amount.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「两次、两倍」，表示次数或数量。

entries.definition: Having two parts or purposes, without the sense of multiplication.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「双重的、双的」，强调两个部分而非翻倍。

entries.definition: An exact copy of something, or to make such a copy.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「复制品；复制」，指完全相同的副本。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the real duo and duplus family and the everyday places two appear.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着真实的 duo 与 duplus 词族，以及「二」出现的日常场合。

normal.en: Duo is two; duplus is two-fold; double keeps both ideas.
normal.cn: duo 是二，duplus 是两倍，double 同时保留这两个意思。

normal.en: A double room holds two people, not necessarily two beds.
normal.cn: double room 供两人住，未必有两张床。

normal.en: To double a price is to make it two times as large.
normal.cn: 把价格 double，就是让它变成原来的两倍。

normal.en: Doubles in tennis means two players on each side.
normal.cn: 网球里的 doubles 指每边两名选手。

normal.en: Doubly means in two ways at the same time.
normal.cn: doubly 表示同时以两种方式。

abstract.en: Picture two lamps on either side of one wide bed.
abstract.cn: 想象一张宽床两侧各有一盏灯。

abstract.en: Picture one price tag replaced by another with twice the number.
abstract.cn: 想象一张价签被另一张数字翻倍的价签换掉。

abstract.en: Picture two pairs of players facing each other across a net.
abstract.cn: 想象两对选手隔着球网相对而立。

examples.en: The recipe calls for a double portion of sugar.
examples.cn: 这个食谱要求双份糖。

examples.en: The company doubled its staff in two years.
examples.cn: 这家公司在两年内把员工人数翻了一倍。

examples.en: She plays doubles with her sister on weekends.
examples.cn: 她周末和妹妹一起打双打。

dict_mnemonic.text: dou 有「二」的影子，-ble 像「折」：一样东西折成两层，就是双的、两倍。

root: 源自拉丁语 duplus（两倍的），由 duo（二）加表示折叠的后缀 -plus 构成，经古法语 doble 进入英语。本义是同一物折成两份，后发展出「双人的」「使加倍」「双打」等义；同族还有 dual、duplicate。

sensesIntro.en: One two-fold idea covers twice the amount, a room for two, the act of doubling, and a match with two on each side.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个「折成两份」的念头，覆盖两倍的数量、供两人用的房间、加倍的动作，以及每边两人的比赛。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one wide bed with two lamps burning on either side.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张宽床，两侧各亮着一盏灯。

branches.en: QUANTITY: the first sense is simply twice as much.
branches.cn: 数量线：第一个义项就是两倍那么多。

branches.en: SHARING: the second sense fits two people into one bed or room.
branches.cn: 合用线：第二个义项让两个人合用一张床或一间房。

branches.en: ACTION: the third sense turns the adjective into the act of multiplying.
branches.cn: 动作线：第三个义项把形容词变成做乘法的动作。

branches.en: SPORT: the fourth sense names a game with two players on each side.
branches.cn: 赛制线：第四个义项给每边两人的比赛命名。

branches.en: Twice the amount and a room for two both come from the same pair.
branches.cn: 两倍的数量与供两人住的房间，都来自同一对「二」。

intro.en: Double goes back to duo, two, and a fold suffix; English adds -ly, -ing and -et.
intro.cn: double 可追到 duo（二）与表示折叠的后缀；英语再加 -ly、-ing 与 -et。

latinIntro.en: Latin duo and duplus are recorded, and duplicare, to double, belongs to the same family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 duo 与 duplus 均有记录，动词 duplicare（使加倍）也属同一词族。

items.exampleCN: 这个数词是第一个成分。

items.example: The adjective already meant twice as much.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词本义就是两倍。

items.example: The word serves as adjective, verb and noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词可作形容词、动词与名词。
